blocks.x: It‟s all economics. So, um, lets‟ go back: so in ‟62 you went to Japan, in ‟63 you went to Japan, but in ‟62 also, something significant happened in your life.
So you went to Japan in ‟61-‟62…?
‟63? So, ‟62 something … this is when you played with Charles Mingus?
Playing with Charles Mingus was after I was separated from, uh….
…Mariano. So, it‟s much later. I, I.… It has to be after ‟64….
So, no, I was there, uh….
So it has to be after that.

So the Mingus…. When Mingus asked me to join, I was really alone and struggling. Barely paying the rent. And uh, my daughter was with my sister in Japan, and—I think she‟d just started kindergarten or something, kindergarten or grammar school, I‟m not quite sure.
So she was born in ‟63, so let‟s go back….
So, for the record, make sure that, in Grove Dictionary they have it listed as ‟62, that is incorrect.
Okay, now, she was born in ‟63, so it has to be, with Mingus, it has to be after ‟66. That‟s what I think.
